name: Cockatrice

actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or begin turning to stone: restrained for 1 round. If still restrained at end of their next turn, they must pass another PHYS save or be petrified.

actions.name: Wing Flap
actions.effect: The Cockatrice hops back 3m after attacking.

reactions.name: Panicked Flutter
reactions.effect: When hit by an attack, the Cockatrice flutters away up to 3m without provoking.

traits.name: Petrification
traits.desc: A creature petrified by the Cockatrice can be restored by greater restoration or similar magic.

lore: Cockatrices are bizarre creatures resembling a rooster with a reptilian tail. Despite their small size and cowardly nature, their bite carries a petrifying venom that can turn creatures to stone, making them far more dangerous than they appear.
